name: research-retro-assistant
description: Turn messy experiment logs into structured, evidence-cited research archives, and look up prior attempts on entry.

displayDescription.en: Turns messy experiment logs into numbered, evidence-cited archives, looks up similar attempts on entry, so failure knowledge becomes searchable, checkable and reusable.
displayDescription.zh: 把杂乱实验记录读成带编号与原文证据的档案，入库即反查同类尝试，失败经验因此可检索、可复核、可复用。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我把一段实验日志贴给你，帮我抽成带证据引用的结构化档案。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Here is a raw experiment log - turn it into a structured archive with evidence citations.

quickPrompts.zh: 我把一段实验日志贴给你，帮我抽成带证据引用的结构化档案。
quickPrompts.en: Here is a raw experiment log - turn it into a structured archive with evidence citations.

quickPrompts.zh: 我刚记完一条失败记录，帮我反查库里有没有同类尝试和冲突判断。
quickPrompts.en: I just logged a failure. Look up similar attempts and contradicting verdicts in my library.

quickPrompts.zh: 把同一阻塞点的记录归纳成一条可立项的假设，并标注证据强度。
quickPrompts.en: Induct records sharing one blocker into a project-ready hypothesis with evidence strength.
